files.phishing_database.txt:
COMMON PHISHING ATTACK PATTERNS

1. Toll/Traffic Violations
- Urgent payment requests
- Fake government agencies
- Time-sensitive threats

- Verification requests
- Reward claims

3. Tech Support
- Security alerts
- Software updates
- Account breaches

- Fear-based messaging

CYBERSECURITY TRAINING GUIDELINES

Objective: Educate users on phishing recognition

- No malicious deployment

- Legal compliance
